Dear Sir/Madam,
Sub: Outcome of the Board Meeting
We refer to our letters dated 24 September 2026 and 12 October 2026 regarding the
captioned subject.
The Board of Directors of the Company, at its meeting held today, inter alia, considered and
approved/took note of the following matters:
1. Unaudited Financial Results
The Board approved the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results of the
Company for the three and six months ended 30 September 2026.
The said financial results, which have been subjected to limited review by the Statutory
Auditors of the Company, together with the Limited Review Reports thereon, are enclosed as
Annexure A.
The unaudited financial results will be published in the newspapers in accordance with
Regulation 47 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations,
2015 ("SEBI Listing Regulations").

2. Changes in Senior Management Personnel
In terms of Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, read with the applicable SEBI
Master Circular, as amended from time to time, we wish to inform you that Dr. Madhu
Sasidhar, a designated Senior Managerial Personnel (SMP) of the Company, will cease to hold
the position of President & CEO - Hospitals Division, effective from the closure of business
hours on November 14, 2026 consequent to the successful completion of his employment
tenure.
There is no material reason for the cessation of his office other than the reason stated above.
During his tenure with the Company, Dr. Madhu Sasidhar made significant contributions
towards strengthening clinical excellence practices and in augmenting the Company's digital
health capabilities.
Leadership Talent Addition
In line with the Company's leadership strengthening initiatives and to ensure seamless
business continuity, based on the recommendation of the Nomination and Remuneration
Committee, the Board of Directors designated the following personnel as Senior Management
Personnel of the Company:
Dr. Ritu Garg, Chief Executive Officer, Multi Regions (North, Central, Western and
Eastern Regions). She has over two decades of healthcare experience, she brings extensive
expertise in operations, growth, transformation and innovation. A clinician by training, she
holds an MBBS, MS and an MBA in Finance & Strategy.

Mr. Anand Wasker, Chief Business Officer- International. He has over 26 years of

3. Completion of Divestment by Apollo Health and Lifestyle Limited in Apollo
Specialty Hospitals Private Limited and Apollo Fertility Centre Private Limited as
well as receipt of consideration and allotment of securities representing an effective
9.9% equity stake in Kids Clinic India Limited
The Company had earlier informed the Stock Exchanges that, at its meeting held on 20 May
2026, the Board had approved the divestment by Apollo Health and Lifestyle Limited ("AHLL"),
a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, of its entire shareholding in Apollo Specialty
Hospitals Private Limited ("ASHPL") and Apollo Fertility Centre Private Limited ("AFCPL") to
Kids Clinic India Limited ("KCIL"), which operates under the brand name "Cloudnine" .
